title.zh: 将南拉瑙省马兰陶市镇伊努达兰中央小学的名称变更为Sultan Guro中央小学的法案
title.en: An Act to Changing the Name of Inudaran Central Elementary School in the Municipality of Marantao, Province of Lanao del Sur, to Sultan Guro Central Elementary School
title.orig: An Act to Changing the Name of Inudaran Central Elementary School in the Municipality of Marantao, Province of Lanao del Sur, to Sultan Guro Central Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường Tiểu học Trung tâm Inudaran tại Đô thị Marantao, Tỉnh Lanao del Sur thành Trường Tiểu học Trung tâm Sultan Guro
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษากลาง Inudaran ในเทศบาล Marantao จังหวัด Lanao del Sur เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษากลาง Sultan Guro
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengubah Nama Sekolah Dasar Pusat Inudaran di Kotamadya Marantao, Provinsi Lanao del Sur menjadi Sekolah Dasar Pusat Sultan Guro
title.ms: Akta Menukar Nama Sekolah Rendah Pusat Inudaran di Perbandaran Marantao, Wilayah Lanao del Sur kepada Sekolah Rendah Pusat Sultan Guro

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1965/ra_4183_1965.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Inudaran Central Elementary School in the Municipality of Marantao, Province of Lanao del Sur, is changed to Sultan Guro Central Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 21, 1965.
